example: Chapter 10, Section sec:ps_lorenz, periodic orbit LR of the Lorenz system
problem: F_0 = sum_j xihat_j (sum_{|k|<=N} a_{j,k} - xi_j), (F_j)_k = i k a_{j,k} - tau0 (phi_j(a))_k, gamma(t) = sum_k a_k e^{ikt/tau0}
norm: X = C x (l^1_nu)^3 with the max norm over the components
moduli: the checker bounds |z| by rational upper bounds; Y0, Z0, Z1, Z2 of the lemmas are recomputed from the data, not stored
unknown_order: tau0, then a_{1,k}, a_{2,k}, a_{3,k} for k = -N..N
A_N: numerical inverse of DF^(N)(xbar), real and imaginary parts rounded to 17 significant decimal digits (full double precision); rows/columns in unknown_order
radii_polynomial: p(r) = Z2 r^2 - (1 - Z0 - Z1) r + Y0 (bounds recomputed from the data, Z2 = Z2(r_*) valid for 0 < r <= r_*) is negative at r0 and r1
